newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA SET PAKISTAN 426 TO WIN FINAL TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA SET PAKISTAN 426 TO WIN FINAL TEST.

text.p: Pakistan were left to score 426 to win the second and final test after a Sri Lanka run spree led by centuries from Sanath Jayasuriya and Aarvinda de Silva on Tuesday
Jayasuriya struck 113 and de Silva lashed 103 not out as Sri Lanka, 39 ahead on first innings, piled up 386 for four in their second innings before declaring shortly after tea on the fourth day.

Sri Lanka, 102 without loss overnight, consolidated as Jayasuriya and Russell Arnold (50) extended their partership to 157 against a depleted attack reduced to two front line bowlers - leg-spinner Mushtaq Ahmed and off-spinner Saqlain Mushtaq.
Jayasuriya completed his century off 195 balls, hitting one six and eight fours, and he went on to beat his previous test best of 112 against Australia at Adelaide in the 1995-96 series.
When he was out after lunch, Sri Lanka sustained their onslaught with a 105-run fourth wicket stand between de Silva and Arjuna Ranatunga.
The pair dominated the afternoon session which produced 142 runs off 25 overs.
Ranatunga went to his half-century first, off 51 balls with the aid of one six and eight fours, and he celebrated by hitting Mushtaq for two consecutive sixes.
But the bowler had his revenge, having Ranatunga stumped by stand-in wicketkeeper Salim Elahi for 66, scored off 62 balls and containing three sixes and nine fours.
De Silva went to his half-century from 61 balls, with five fours, and completed his third successive hundred of the series after tea.
